summary: Backend regression tests for FASE 4 JWT_SECRET fix executed. 18/20 tests PASSED (90%). CRITICAL FIX VERIFIED: JWT_SECRET now loads correctly from /app/backend/.env with proper newlines, tokens issued pre-restart remain valid post-restart (confirmed with sudo supervisorctl restart backend), same secret used across restarts. Auth v2 web cookie flow, refresh rotation, logout revocation, brute-force lockout (429 after 5 fails), /api/health, /api/livez, /api/ready, menu HTML render with WebSocket auto-reload, media upload (legacy fallback), presign 503, .exe rejection, startup_check.py fail-fast exit 2 on glued .env vars, A40 Basic Auth on /api/wp-json/wp/v2/comments, and audit_log ingestion (login_success/login_failed/logout) all PASS. TWO real backend bugs found that main agent should fix: (1) POST /api/auth/v2/login with client_type='native' does NOT return refresh_token in body — response_model=TokenResp strips it. (2) X-RateLimit-* headers absent on /api/auth/v2/login — @limiter.limit decorator not applied to any auth_v2 route; slowapi rules only cover /api/media/upload.

critical.issue: refresh_token is NEVER returned in the JSON body for native clients. RCA: @router.post('/login', response_model=TokenResp) — the TokenResp Pydantic model (auth_v2.py line 320) declares only {access_token, token_type, expires_in, user}, so FastAPI strips the refresh_token key even though the handler correctly puts it in payload_out (auth_v2.py line 375). This breaks the mobile/Expo refresh flow entirely (the mobile app has no way to receive its refresh token). Fix: add `refresh_token: Optional[str] = None` to TokenResp, or remove response_model on /login.

X-RateLimit-Limit / X-RateLimit-Remaining / X-RateLimit-Reset headers are ABSENT on /api/auth/v2/login. RCA: none of the endpoints in build_auth_router (auth_v2.py) are decorated with @limiter.limit(LIMITS.login/register/refresh/change_pass). The LIMITS class in rate_limit.py is only wired into /api/media/upload (server.py line 539). SlowAPIMiddleware is installed but has no rules to emit headers for auth routes. Brute-force still works (DB-based counter) but the per-IP slowapi soft-rate-limit contract required by FASE 2 is not enforced. Fix: apply @limiter.limit(LIMITS.login) on /login, LIMITS.register on /register, LIMITS.refresh on /refresh, LIMITS.change_pass on /change-password (import limiter from rate_limit).

action_items: Fix TokenResp model: add `refresh_token: Optional[str] = None` (or drop response_model on /login) so native clients receive their refresh token.
Wire slowapi @limiter.limit decorators on every /api/auth/v2/* endpoint (login/register/refresh/change-password) so X-RateLimit-* headers are emitted and per-IP soft protection is active.
Consider also decorating /api/auth/v2/logout with an appropriate limit.
